verdict.rationale: Bitwarden documents its own vault export of logins and notes, and a community user reports that importing from Bitwarden into KeePassXC was trivial, which corroborates that you can actually leave. However, the evidence never names the export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), so 'open formats' is unproven, and 'all of my data' is only described as 'logins and notes'. missing for 10: documented open export formats, evidence that exports cover all data types (attachments, passkeys, Authenticator codes), first-party docs on migrating to non-Bitwarden destinations

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export your vault data, including logins and notes, to back up important information or transfer to a new Bitwarden vault.
They say importing from Bitwarden was trivial and the KeePass experience is now significantly better.
